subject: cult-info-dy
title: CULT.INFO.DY.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in WAM-21, embedded in Braxton's argument that western art music has 'established a projection that corresponds to the dynamics of the composer rather than the total group' through the institutionalization of notation. CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) is *crossed* — (c) prefix — with MT-INFO (music information): the question is what happens to music information when culture's information dynamics have been re-shaped by composer-centric notation. The diagram routes the crossing: CULT-INFO-DY → MT-INFO branches into AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and AFTD (affinity tendencies), while a parallel branch CULT-INFO-DY → SOC-RT → PRI-INFO → IST-F closes via a *dashed* edge to (r)INTR (interpretation). The structural claim mirrors Braxton's prose: under composer-as-medium, music information's path to affinity dynamics/tendencies has been institutionally *separated* from its grounding in social reality and primary information — and the chain back to interpretation now passes through *isolated focus* and arrives only conditionally. The musician interpreting from notation is what the dashed edge encodes.
